density.title: Density
density.text: `density="compact"` reduces the vertical padding from 16px to 8px. Use it in long lists on large screens; keep the default on touch screens.

iconColor.title: Icon color
iconColor.text: `iconColor` accepts `default` (white backgrounds), `on-color` (colored backgrounds) and `highlight` (emphasis). The icon takes the color, so pass it without its own.

states.title: Loading and disabled
states.text: `loading` shows a skeleton in place of the content. `disabled` mutes the row, turns the tag neutral and stops the callbacks.

divider.title: Divider
divider.text: Rows show an inset divider below. Set `showDivider={false}` on the last row of a group, so it does not double the container border.

contentAndAmount: This component renders [Content List Default](docs:components-lists-content-list-content-list-default--overview) on the left and [Content List Amount](docs:components-lists-content-list-content-list-amount--overview) on the right. Pass their props in `content` and `amount`; amount types, strikethrough, tag and sizes are documented there.

platforms.text: The same component exists in the iOS and Android libraries, with the same blocks.

api.intro: Changing the controls updates the example below. The values are kept while you stay on this page.
api.name: Name
api.invalidJson: Invalid JSON: the previous value is kept.
api.icon: Leading icon, 24px. Pass it without its own color; it follows `iconColor`.
api.iconChild: Timeline icon, 16px. Pass it without its own color.
api.iconColor: Icon color: `default` on white, `on-color` on colored backgrounds, `highlight` for emphasis. Ignored when disabled.
api.iconColorChild: Icon color. Without it, child items use their own light color; an explicit value overrides it. Ignored when disabled.
api.showDivider: Divider below the row, inset 16px. Turn it off on the last row of a group.
api.loading: Shows the skeleton in place of the content.
api.disabled: Mutes the row: inactive content and amount, neutral tag, no callbacks.
api.onClick: Called once per click. Not called while disabled or loading.
api.className: Class on the root element. `ref` and the other attributes go to the {target}.
api.content: Props of [Content List Default](docs:components-lists-content-list-content-list-default--overview): title, description, caption, status, size.
api.amount: Props of [Content List Amount](docs:components-lists-content-list-content-list-amount--overview): value, type, tag, info, size.

tokens.intro: Generated from the component styles at build time. Values without an Ocean token are marked.
tokens.blocks: Content and amount tokens are listed in [Content List Default](docs:components-lists-content-list-content-list-default--overview) and [Content List Amount](docs:components-lists-content-list-content-list-amount--overview).
